user.title: Connect Panasonic China
user.description: Sign in to discover supported appliances. Startup and state updates do not send controls. Entity actions or your HA automations can operate devices. HA stores your credentials; protect the configuration and backups.

reconfigure.title: Change account or password
reconfigure.description: New credentials are saved and the integration reloaded after login and device checks pass. Failed checks leave the old configuration in place. The same device keeps its entity identifiers.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed ({detail}). Check your account and network. The existing configuration is unchanged.
error.no_devices: No supported device found. Check the model and protocol: F-75C5PJD / AirconCommon-2024-01 / Fridge-19.

abort.already_configured: This account has already been added.
